component.name: MGS Recomp
component.summary: Native MGS runtime with modern Vulkan graphics

description.p: An experimental native runtime for the original USA v1.0 game, with a modern Vulkan presentation and controller-accessible launcher.
Import both original discs locally. Game data is not included. Continuous campaign completion is not yet certified.
alpha.1 is an UNTESTED experimental prerelease. Gameplay and platform compatibility of these packages are not certified.
First public alpha.1 packages for early testing. UNTESTED.
